reviewer.name: Independent native date reviewer (campaign nov24 wave 2)

summary: Independent pass on sealed packet (132 items, 40 people, 122 units). Da Kang office/death rows with literal 大康/三年 wording, undated executions, and Qiantong posthumous honors are supported. Nine rows need repair: mis-pinned 大康 attestations on units s0010/s0033–s0055, Tang Dezong retrospective intervals, and empty death on 乾統中 卒.
